01 / THE WALLET

A wallet that minds
its own business.

Zucchini brings self-custody and shielded Zcash payments into an everyday wallet. You hold the keys. You decide what to share.

01

Private payments.
Public confidence.

Send and receive shielded ZEC. Keep payment details off the public ledger when using shielded transactions.

02

Your keys.
Your call.

Your recovery phrase belongs to you. Zucchini does not hold your funds or receive your wallet’s spending keys.

03

Open code.
Nothing to hide.

Explore the wallet’s source, follow its development, and see how the pieces fit together.

Explore the source ↗
02 / LESS FRICTION. MORE FREEDOM.

Make yourself
at home.

01

Create your wallet

Set up a wallet or restore one with your recovery phrase. Back it up somewhere only you can access.

02

Receive shielded ZEC

Share your Unified Address, then let your wallet sync with the Zcash network.

03

Send on your terms

Check the recipient, amount and network fee. Approve the payment from your wallet.
